jobs.title: Commercial Solar PV Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Join Us**

Bord Gáis Energy has been powering the nation’s homes and businesses for 50 years. Today we are evolving from a utility supplier to a total energy solutions provider – combining trusted gas and electricity expertise with a growing portfolio of net zero products and services. We are at the forefront of Ireland’s energy transition strengthening energy security and helping customers moves to a low carbon future. Ardrar Ltd, recently acquired by Bord Gáis Energy (part of Centrica plc), is scaling rapidly as a leading provider of solar solutions across Ireland.

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth business, leveraging the strength of an established and trusted brand, Bord Gáis Energy, in the Irish market, backed by an international energy group (Centrica Plc).

**Your Team (Ardrar Ltd – A Bord Gáis Energy Company)**

Ardrar Ltd, part of the Bord Gáis Energy family, is one of Ireland’s fastest-growing providers of smart, sustainable energy solutions. We combine the agility of a rapidly scaling, technology-led business with the strength and reach of an established brand and energy leader in the Irish market

**Employment Terms**

This role is employed by Ardrar Ltd, which operates under separate terms and conditions to Bord Gáis Energy. Together we’re helping homes, farms and businesses cut costs, reduce emissions, and transition to cleaner energy.

**The Role**

We are seeking a **Commercial Solar PV Design Engineer** to support the next phase of transformation as we accelerate our transition to a more sustainable energy future. This role is central to our technical delivery, responsible for designing optimised, compliant, and cost-effective solar PV systems for commercial, industrial, and agricultural customers across Ireland.

You will work closely with our sales, project management, and installation teams to translate customer requirements and site conditions into engineered solutions that maximise energy yield, meet grid connection requirements, and align with project budgets and timelines.

**Core Responsibilities**

*System Design & Engineering*

* Design and develop detailed solar PV proposals for rooftop and ground-mounted commercial solar PV systems (typically 50 kWp to 5 MWp).
* Conduct virtual and physical site assessments to evaluate solar resources, perform shading analysis, and determine optimal system configuration.
* Create detailed technical reports including module layouts, string configurations, and array designs that maximise energy production while respecting structural, electrical, and fire safety constraints.
* Prepare single-line diagrams (SLDs), three-line diagrams, panel layouts, wiring diagrams, and earthing/lightning protection designs.
* Perform DC and AC cable sizing, voltage drop calculations, and protection device coordination.
* Select and specify major equipment including PV modules, inverters, mounting structures, combiner boxes, and balance of system components.
* Use industry-standard software (PVsyst, Helioscope, or equivalent) to perform energy yield simulations and estimate system production.
* Conduct shading and loss analysis, incorporating weather data, soiling assumptions, degradation rates, and system performance ratios.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration*

* Provide technical support to the commercial sales team during the tender and proposal stage, including design, yield estimates, and equipment specifications.
* Create detailed pricing files including full Bill of Materials (BOM) for each project.
* Liaise with suppliers to get up to date pricing for materials.
* Work closely with project managers to resolve design-related RFIs, review contractor submittals, and support construction-phase engineering.
* Collaborate with structural and civil engineers on racking, foundation, and roof loading assessments for complex installations.
* Provide technical guidance to installation and commissioning teams, troubleshooting design or construction issues in the field.

*Technical Documentation & Compliance*

* Prepare engineering deliverables including stamped drawings, design specifications, equipment submittal and as-built drawings.
* Ensure all designs comply with Irish and EU standards, building regulations, ESB Networks grid connection requirements, and SEAI grant specifications.
* Support pre-install team by preparing technical documentation for ESB Networks and local authority planning submissions.

**Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering, Civil/Structural Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent relevant industry experience).
* Minimum 2–4 years' experience in commercial or utility-scale solar PV system design.
* Proficiency in solar design software such as PVsyst, Helioscope, Opensolar or equivalent.
* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD or similar CAD software for producing construction-ready drawings.
* Solid understanding of solar PV technology, electrical systems, and grid interconnection requirements.
* Knowledge of Irish and EU electrical standards, building regulations, and ESB Networks grid connection processes.
* Experience preparing single-line diagrams, cable sizing calculations, and Bills of Materials.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Full clean driver's license (some site visits required).

**Why should you apply?**

This is your chance to shape Ireland’s clean energy future. You’ll work in a fast-growing business, collaborate with top talent, and accelerate your development every step of the way. This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth business with the backing of a national energy leader with a trusted heritage brand, Bord Gáis Energy is part of Centrica plc, a leading international energy and services company. Benefit from the scale, investment, and expertise of the Bord Gáis Energy / Centrica Group.

Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: €55,000.00-€65,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Relevant: 1 year (required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer AI
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role
  
Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely.
  
  
In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data.
  
  
What you will do
  
Maintain Performance
  

* Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance.

  
Debug and Test
  

* Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running.

  
Develop for the Future
  

* Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services.

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience
  
  

* Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects.
* Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software.
* Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services.
* Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues.
* Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns.

  
Preferred skills and experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl.
* Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Sr Software Development Engineer, Buyer Safety Experience
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

“WARNING: Choking Hazard — small parts. Not for children under 3 years.”  
  
“WARNING: This product can expose you to chemicals including antimony trioxide, which are known to cause cancer or birth defects or other reproductive harm.”  
  
Have you ever seen these warning labels on popular and seemingly innocent products, such as fidget spinners or food containers? As the Buyer Safety Experience team for Amazon Retail worldwide, we aim to raise the bar when it comes to educating and empowering consumers about product safety. Our team is responsible for the complete end-to-end safety experience for buyers — from the warnings you see on the product detail pages (and how to turn them into useful, actionable information), to making safer product recommendations targeted to each individual consumer’s needs, to informing consumers of recalled products and preventing them from being delivered to their doorstep.  
  
As the founding engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience - Romania team, you’ll be able to build the groundwork and influence its direction for the years to come. Our work cuts across various disciplines — from delivering an awesome customer and brand experience via great UI/UX, to building massively scalable distributed systems to support the most high-traffic pages on Amazon worldwide, to analytical and feedback systems which give us data-driven customer insights, to using GenAI to enable Selling Partners and brands to keep customers safe and informed. If you have a passion for both consumer and business-facing applications, and are obsessed with customer experience, we want you!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
As the first Software Development Engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience team in Romania, you will hire and lead a brand new team, and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders worldwide across Program and Product. Your role will be heavily customer-obsessed, building solutions to ensure Amazon is Earth's safest place to shop.  
  
A day in the life  

* Hiring: Build a new team from scratch
* Deeply understand technical decisions, influence long-term architecture
* Define the team's yearly goals and long-term technical vision and charter, along with product and business stakeholders
* Work closely with international stakeholders across our VP-level Trustworthy Shopping Experience org, in addition to TPM and PM-T

  
Key job responsibilities  
As the first Software Development Engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience team in RO, you will hire and lead a new team, and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders worldwide across Program and Product. Your role will be heavily customer-obsessed, building solutions to ensure Amazon is Earth's safest place to shop.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
* Experience in development in the last 3 years

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer .NET
jobs.description:
**¿Quiénes somos?**
===================

En Solusoft, con más de 30 años de experiencia desarrollando soluciones tecnológicas innovadoras, seguimos creciendo con nuevos proyectos y grandes retos.

Buscamos un/a **Senior Full Stack Developer en .NET** que quiera diseñar, construir y optimizar soluciones escalables, seguras y eficientes, y que además disfrute liderando técnicamente a su equipo y participando en decisiones clave del proyecto.

**¿Qué harás en tu día a día como Senior Full Stack Developer?**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* Diseñar y documentar soluciones técnicas con visión arquitectónica.
* Definir y aplicar estándares de desarrollo, buenas prácticas y patrones de diseño.
* Liderar técnicamente al equipo de desarrollo, acompañando su evolución
* Evaluar nuevas tecnologías y herramientas para mejorar la eficiencia y seguridad de los proyectos.
* Asegurar la integración de sistemas y aplicaciones.
* Implementar pruebas automáticas, calidad continua y despliegues controlados.

**Requisitos**
--------------

* Al menos 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software sobre tecnologías .NET.
* Experiencia en desarrollo web y de APIs.
* Conocimiento y experiencia en entornos cloud (preferiblemente Azure).
* Experiencia con microservicios, Docker y Kubernetes.
* Conocimientos sólidos en bases de datos SQL y NoSQL.
* Experiencia en integración y despliegue de aplicaciones.
* Habilidades de liderazgo y comunicación.
* Experiencia en pruebas de rendimiento y seguridad.

**¿Qué ofrecemos?**
-------------------

Modelo de **trabajo híbrido** +

* Al menos dos mañanas presenciales a la semana en el Parque Tecnológico de Leganés.
* El resto remoto con excelente organización y comunicación.

### **Horarios flexibles y conciliación**

Lunes a jueves: 08:00 - 14:00 y 15:00 - 17:30.

Viernes: jornada intensiva de 08:00 - 15:00.

Una tarde libre adicional a la semana.

Jornada intensiva en verano y horarios especiales en Navidad.

### **Ambiente laboral y desarrollo profesional**

Muy buen ambiente de trabajo .

Formación continua .

Trabaja con nosotros en proyectos innovadores.

**¿Te interesa?**
-----------------

¿Buscas un lugar donde desarrollar tu talento y sentir que tu esfuerzo cuenta de verdad?

En Solusoft cada día es una oportunidad real para desarrollarte en el sector TIC. Si te motiva la tecnología, disfrutas trabajando en equipo y quieres formar parte de una empresa donde las personas están en el centro, déjanos tu CV. **¡Da el siguiente paso en tu carrera y súmate a nuestro equipo!**

**¿Dónde estamos?**
-------------------

Nos encontramos en el **Parque Tecnológico de Leganés**, al que podrás llegar en transporte público o en coche y tendrás posibilidad de aparcar con gran facilidad.
